prompt:
You are two people at once: a first-time viewer scrolling a vertical-video feed who has NEVER
seen this show and knows none of its characters, and the ad buyer who decides which clips get paid reach.
Each clip below is written out exactly as it would play (t = seconds since the clip began; a new
segment means a hard cut). Speaker names are production notes: a real viewer only learns a name if
someone says it out loud or it is obvious from the picture.

For every clip, answer honestly and use the full 1-10 range (most clips are not a 9):
- first_3s_hook: judged ONLY on what happens between t=0 and t=3. 1 = nothing would stop a scroll.
- cliffhanger_open: at the final cut, how badly does the viewer need to know what happens next?
  1 = everything is settled.
- cold_viewer_clarity: can a stranger tell who these people are to each other and what is at stake,
  from this clip alone? 1 = lost.
- ambiguity: every concrete confusion, each with kind = pronoun | relationship | unexplained_name |
  prior_event | speaker_identity, the beat_id where it happens, and a short detail. Empty list if none.
- ending_resolves_tension: true if the last beats answer or defuse the tension.
- Boundary fixes (optional; only beat_ids printed inside that clip):
  trim_start_to = the beat that should open the clip if the current first 3 seconds are weak
                  (must be in segment 1); trim_end_at = the beat the clip should cut on if the current
                  ending lets the air out (must be in the last segment). Use null when the boundary is right.
  Clips must stay 20-60 seconds; a trim that breaks that is discarded. Give trim_reason when you trim.
- hook_line and cliffhanger_line: copy the exact words from the clip text (no beat id, no speaker).
- viewer_takeaway: one sentence - what a stranger thinks this story is about.
- why_it_works: one line for the ad buyer.

### CLIP B-E47B064-E47B040 (34.6 s, 2 segment(s))
== segment 1/2 - cold open (flash-forward) - episode 47 ==
t=000.0 E47.B064 LINE: CATHERINE (Choked, Humiliated): "You humiliate me."   <- inside first 3 seconds
t=002.6 E47.B065 SHOT: Medium shot of both women standing beneath the cathedral vaulting of the hall.   <- inside first 3 seconds
t=003.0 E47.B066 LINE: JULIANA (Calm, Sovereign): "I offer you bread and honest labor. Take the apron, or leave the county."
== segment 2/2 - main scene - episode 47 ==
t=008.0 E47.B025 SHOT: Medium shot of Lady Ashbourne leaning heavily on her walking cane, glaring down at Catherine who kneels in the mud.
t=008.0 E47.B026 LINE: LADY ASHBOURNE (Sharp, Contemptuous): "You dare show your face in Ashbourne courtyard?"
t=011.2 E47.B027 SHOT: High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in her disheveled burgundy gown, clutching her skirts and weeping profusely.
t=011.7 E47.B028 LINE: CATHERINE (Desperate, Weeping): "I have nowhere to go, Your Grace."
t=014.7 E47.B029 SHOT: Low-angle shot tracking Catherine clutching her chest in agony.
t=014.7 E47.B030 LINE: CATHERINE (Sobbing, Pleading): "London closed its doors! My family disowned me!"
t=018.2 E47.B031 SHOT: Medium close-up of Lady Ashbourne, her gloved hand resting on her cane as she delivers her cold judgment.
t=018.4 E47.B032 LINE: LADY ASHBOURNE (Cold, Unforgiving): "She aided the poison in my veins. Cast her into the road."
t=022.7 E47.B033 SHOT: Medium shot of Vaughn drawing his baton, ready to seize Catherine from behind.
t=023.0 E47.B034 LINE: VAUGHN (Gruff, Ready): "One command, Your Grace, and I drag her past the gates."
t=026.0 E47.B035 SHOT: Wide shot as Alexander strides purposefully into the courtyard alongside Juliana, his coat billowing behind him.
t=026.4 E47.B036 LINE: ALEXANDER (Furious, Decisive): "Do it, Vaughn! Throw her past the estate perimeter!"
t=030.0 E47.B037 SHOT: Close-up of Catherine collapsed on the wet stones, looking up with tear-streaked panic.
t=030.0 E47.B038 LINE: CATHERINE (Hysterical, Screaming): "Please, Alexander! Have mercy!"
t=033.0 E47.B039 SHOT: Medium shot of Juliana raising her right hand firmly to halt the guard.
t=033.4 E47.B040 LINE: JULIANA (Clear, Authoritative): "Stop."
t=034.6 == CLIP ENDS ==
### CLIP A-E48-002-013 (24.1 s, 1 segment(s))
== segment 1/1 - continuous - episode 48 ==
t=000.0 E48.B002 LINE: CATHERINE (Vindictive, Cold): "Two words, and that healer's crown rolls right back into the gutter where it belongs."   <- inside first 3 seconds
t=002.1 E48.B003 SHOT: Close-up on Catherine's profile and jewelry as she speaks with calculating contempt.   <- inside first 3 seconds
t=005.4 E48.B004 ACTION: Catherine glides across the chamber past a roaring stone hearth, picking up an orange from a silver platter on the table.
t=005.6 E48.B005 LINE: CATHERINE (Scheming): "Ten days. He gave himself ten days to fix it."
t=009.9 E48.B006 SHOT: Medium close-up frontal shot of Catherine turning directly toward the viewer, her expression tightening into ruthless determination.
t=010.2 E48.B007 LINE: CATHERINE (Intense, Measured): "Ten days for the council to sit."
t=012.6 E48.B008 ACTION: Catherine raises a gloved index finger, emphasizing each point with sinister precision.
t=012.7 E48.B009 LINE: CATHERINE (Calculating): "Ten days for witnesses to be gathered."
t=015.0 E48.B010 LINE: CATHERINE (Dark, Threatening): "Ten days for a decree to be undone."
t=017.6 E48.B011 SHOT: Slight push-in on Catherine as she clenches her fist against her chest, her eyes blazing with malice.
t=017.7 E48.B012 LINE: CATHERINE (Menacing, Resolute): "Ten days is not a wall, Alexander. It's a door."
t=021.5 E48.B013 LINE: CATHERINE (Chillingly Calm): "And doors can be closed from the other side."
t=024.1 == CLIP ENDS ==
### CLIP A-E48-012-040 (53.3 s, 1 segment(s))
== segment 1/1 - continuous - episode 48 ==
t=000.0 E48.B012 LINE: CATHERINE (Menacing, Resolute): "Ten days is not a wall, Alexander. It's a door."   <- inside first 3 seconds
t=003.8 E48.B013 LINE: CATHERINE (Chillingly Calm): "And doors can be closed from the other side."
t=006.6 E48.B014 SHOT: Medium shot over Catherine's shoulder seated before her vanity mirror as the chamber door eases open and Agnes enters quietly.
t=006.7 E48.B015 ACTION: Agnes, dressed in a grey maid's dress and white apron, steps inside with cautious hesitation and clasps her hands.
t=009.1 E48.B016 LINE: AGNES (Hushed, Submissive): "You sent for me, my lady?"
t=010.8 E48.B017 LINE: CATHERINE (Commanding, Sharp): "Lock it."
t=011.9 E48.B018 SHOT: Close-up on Agnes's hands turning the ornate iron key in the wooden door's brass lock.
t=012.2 E48.B019 SOUND: Heavy metallic click of an iron key latching into a deadbolt.
t=013.9 E48.B020 ACTION: Catherine strides forward and firmly grasps Agnes by both hands, stepping uncomfortably close.
t=013.9 E48.B021 SHOT: Two-shot profile of Catherine towering over Agnes in the candlelight.
t=014.1 E48.B022 LINE: CATHERINE (Fierce, Hissing): "Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today."
t=017.2 E48.B023 LINE: CATHERINE (Spiteful, calculating): "Good. Let them remember it."
t=019.1 E48.B024 LINE: CATHERINE (Sinister, Predatory): "Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now."
t=022.9 E48.B025 SHOT: Over-the-shoulder close-up on Agnes, her brow furrowed in anxious alarm.
t=023.2 E48.B026 LINE: AGNES (Anxious, Whispering): "My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county."
t=026.7 E48.B027 SHOT: Close-up on Catherine, a smug, venomous smile spreading across her painted lips.
t=026.9 E48.B028 LINE: CATHERINE (Confident, Devious): "I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house."
t=031.4 E48.B029 SHOT: Medium tracking shot following Catherine as she releases Agnes and stalks across the room toward the window sill.
t=031.9 E48.B030 LINE: CATHERINE (Pleased, Scheming): "Father Thomas did his part beautifully today."
t=035.1 E48.B031 LINE: CATHERINE (Calculated, Demanding): "Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes."
t=038.1 E48.B032 SHOT: Medium close-up of Agnes glancing nervously over her shoulder.
t=038.4 E48.B033 LINE: AGNES (Apprehensive): "If someone sees him come to you..."
t=040.9 E48.B034 SHOT: Close-up on Catherine spinning around from the window, her jaw set in terrifying firmness.
t=041.7 E48.B035 LINE: CATHERINE (Stern, Threatening): "Then no one sees him."
t=044.2 E48.B036 LINE: CATHERINE (Authoritative): "That is precisely your job tonight."
t=046.8 E48.B037 SHOT: Medium shot as Catherine picks up a heavy velvet coin purse and places it firmly into Agnes's awaiting open palms.
t=047.4 E48.B038 SOUND: Dull clinking of heavy gold coins inside a leather pouch.
t=047.7 E48.B039 LINE: CATHERINE (Hushed, Commanding): "Send for the priest. Tonight."
t=050.7 E48.B040 LINE: CATHERINE (Firm, Final): "And make sure no one sees him arrive."
t=053.3 == CLIP ENDS ==
### CLIP A-E49-036-045 (28.6 s, 1 segment(s))
== segment 1/1 - continuous - episode 49 ==
t=000.0 E49.B036 LINE: CATHERINE (Fierce, Uncompromising): "Second, I want to know what the council knows before it decides anything. Every argument, every witness, every whisper against her."   <- inside first 3 seconds
t=007.2 E49.B037 SHOT: Close-up on Father Thomas absorbing the audacity of her demand.
t=007.4 E49.B038 LINE: FATHER THOMAS (Skeptical): "You want eyes inside the council chamber itself?"
t=010.0 E49.B039 SHOT: Close-up low angle on Catherine, tilting her chin up in defiant pride.
t=010.2 E49.B040 LINE: CATHERINE (Haughty, Imperious): "I want eyes and ears everywhere that decides my future."
t=013.8 E49.B041 SHOT: Full two-shot of Catherine and Father Thomas facing off across the small table in the cavernous hallway.
t=014.0 E49.B042 ACTION: Father Thomas clasps his hands behind his back, turning slightly away to ponder the gravity of her words.
t=014.1 E49.B043 LINE: CATHERINE (Bitterly Resolute): "Is that so unreasonable coming from a woman the church itself just humiliated back into relevance?"
t=019.6 E49.B044 SHOT: Medium shot on Father Thomas turning back around to face her, his countenance etched with genuine concern.
t=020.0 E49.B045 LINE: FATHER THOMAS (Wary, Grave): "If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?"
t=028.6 == CLIP ENDS ==
### CLIP A-E49-049-062 (26.6 s, 1 segment(s))
== segment 1/1 - continuous - episode 49 ==
t=000.0 E49.B049 LINE: FATHER THOMAS (Stern, Stark): "Careful men still hang, my lady, when the crime is treason against a Duke the King himself just restored."   <- inside first 3 seconds
t=006.6 E49.B050 SHOT: Close-up on Catherine, her lips parting into an alluring, promising smile.
t=006.8 E49.B051 LINE: CATHERINE (Tempting): "Careful men who help me also get remembered."
t=010.6 E49.B052 SHOT: Split focus close-up between Father Thomas's intense gaze and Catherine leaning in close, whispering with lethal conviction.
t=011.0 E49.B053 LINE: CATHERINE (Whispering, Promising): "A grateful Duchess collects debts differently than a desperate one."
t=016.3 E49.B054 SHOT: Medium two-shot as Father Thomas extends his open right hand between them.
t=016.8 E49.B055 ACTION: Father Thomas slowly raises his right hand, palm turned upward in invitation and pact.
t=017.0 E49.B056 LINE: FATHER THOMAS (Low, Resigned): "The rest depends on how well you keep your part of this quiet."
t=021.6 E49.B057 SHOT: Close-up on Father Thomas looking down into her eyes.
t=021.8 E49.B058 LINE: FATHER THOMAS (Softly): "Then we understand each other."
t=022.3 E49.B059 ACTION: Catherine reaches out and places her slender hand firmly into Father Thomas's open palm.
t=024.6 E49.B060 SHOT: Close-up of Catherine gazing up at him, her eyes glistening in the candlelight.
t=024.8 E49.B061 LINE: CATHERINE (Intimate): "We always have."
t=025.8 E49.B062 SHOT: Extreme close-up as Father Thomas gently raises his other hand and cups Catherine's cheek tenderly, her hand resting against his chest as she leans into his touch before cutting to black.
t=026.6 == CLIP ENDS ==
